APP_TAGLINE: A polished Vanilla+ setup for Bully: Scholarship Edition
STEP1_DESC: Choose the folder that contains Bully.exe.
STEP2_DESC: Recommended defaults preserve the original Bully feel.
SILENT_DESC: Stability, crash fixes and FPS limiter.
ESSENTIAL_DESC: Mission fixes, softlock fixes and better 60 FPS compatibility.
VISUAL_DESC: Optional vanilla-friendly lighting and shadow polish. Core fixes can continue even if this mod fails.
STEP3_DESC: Choose how Nexus mods are downloaded. You can switch modes at any time.
REMEMBER_KEY: Remember securely for this Windows user (DPAPI)
STEP4_DESC: A rollback backup is created before changes. You can launch the game immediately after setup.
RUS_NOTE: After installation, the app will separately ask whether to enable Russian in Bully itself.
READY: Ready to install • choose Auto or Slow Download
FOOTER_NOTICE: Unofficial community installer • third-party mods remain with their original authors
ABOUT_BODY: This project automates a clean starter setup while keeping every third-party mod credited and linked to its original source. Mod files remain the property of their respective authors.
ERR_BULLY_NOT_FOUND: Bully.exe was not found in that folder.
WARN_CHOOSE_GAME: Choose the correct Bully folder first — it must contain Bully.exe.
WARN_FPS: For the stable starter preset, FPS limit must be a number from 30 to 60. 60 is recommended.
WARN_NEXUS_KEY: An API key is optional. Leave it blank to use the official Nexus browser-assisted flow.
NEXUS_NEEDS_AUTH: A Nexus API key is required. Free accounts cannot receive unattended API download links, so Starter Kit will automatically fall back to the official Slow Download page.
NEXUS_CHECK_KEY: Could not authenticate with Nexus Mods. Check the API key and try again.
NEXUS_SAVED_FOUND: Saved API key found — click Test Connection
NO_BACKUPS: No Bully Starter Kit backups were found.
RESTORE_DONE: Latest backup restored. New files were removed and overwritten originals were restored.
GAME_RUS_PROMPT:
Mods are installed. Enable Russian in Bully itself?

UI and subtitles will be Russian. Voice acting remains English. Steam uses the game's built-in localization, so no separate translation download is needed.
GAME_RUS_ENABLED:
Russian language for Bully was enabled.

If you use Steam, keep the game language set to English in Steam properties. Enable subtitles in the in-game settings.
GAME_RUS_ALREADY: Russian language for Bully was already enabled.
GAME_RUS_UNSUPPORTED: 12200_install.vdf was not found. On Rockstar/retail editions, Russian availability depends on the specific build/installed language; use Rockstar’s official Russian build/patch when applicable. Starter Kit did not modify game files automatically.
GAME_RUS_PATTERN_FAIL: The language setting could not be safely identified in 12200_install.vdf. Russian was not enabled; the other mods were installed normally.
PUBLIC_BETA_NOTE: Personal API keys are used for beta testing. Free accounts download Nexus files through the official Slow Download flow; Premium may download directly through the API.
RESTART_LANG: Interface language changed. The app will restart.

COMPLETE_BODY: You can launch Bully now. If you ever want the original files back, use Restore in Starter Kit.
DOWNLOAD_AUTO_DESC: Starter Kit resolves the current file through the Nexus API and downloads it automatically. Direct downloads require Premium.
DOWNLOAD_SLOW_DESC: Free Nexus flow: Starter Kit opens the correct page, then automatically picks up the ZIP after your click.
DOWNLOAD_SLOW_STEP1: 1. Starter Kit opens the official Nexus file page.
DOWNLOAD_SLOW_STEP3: 3. The archive is detected and validated automatically.
DOWNLOAD_SLOW_HINT: No mirrors: only the original Nexus page and archive validation before installation.
